entities.summary: Felipe Aláiz de Pablo was an Aragonese anarchist writer, translator and journalist. He began writing for the anarchist press during the 1910s and went on to edit some of the movement's principle publications during the 1930s. His main work, Hacia una federación de autonomías ibéricas, advocates for Iberism, municipalism and collectivism, and criticises Spanish nationalism and statism.
